rakshasa.name: Rakshasa
damage_vulnerabilities: Piercing damage from weapons wielded by

special_abilities.name: Greater Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa’s permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

special_abilities.name: Fiendish Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rakshasa makes three Cursed Touch attacks.

actions.name: Cursed Touch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Baleful Command (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each enemy in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the rakshasa. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions until the start of the rakshasa’s next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The rakshasa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Fly, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift Red Dragons

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 24 (7d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

special_abilities.name: Heat Aura
special_abilities.desc: At the end of each of the remorhaz’s turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz’s turns. If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the Prone condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

bonus_actions.name: Swoop (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: If the roc has a creature Grappled, the roc flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 60 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the grapple ends. The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has Grappled when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper’s next turn.

actions.name: Reel
actions.desc: The roper pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

special_abilities.name: Iron Scent
special_abilities.desc: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.desc: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure: The object takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.

actions.name: Destroy Metal
actions.desc: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn’t being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.

reactions.name: Reflexive Antennae
reactions.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae. Sahuagin

special_abilities.name: Agile
special_abilities.desc: The rat doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy’s reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

special_abilities.name: Mimicry
special_abilities.desc: The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or chitter. A hearer can discern the sounds are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The shark has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature and the rhinoceros moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.
